evidence: For SnO2 deposition, the cycles of TMT saturation and oxidization with plasma-excited humidiﬁed Ar were repeated at room temperatures of 23–28◦C, with optimal conditions determined by MIRIRAS analysis corresponding to a TMT saturation exposure of 2× 105 Langmuir (1 Langmuir= 1× 10−6 Torr s= 1.33× 10−4 Pa s) and an oxidization time of 10 min.
